title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Price Schedule: Calibration, Alignment, Diagnostic, Fleet and Sublet Handling Figures
content:
The ADAS Sensor Calibrations price schedule sets, for each tier, the calibration price and the alignment, diagnostic, discount and handling figures that the network's billing rules read. Amounts are in US dollars (USD); percentages are percent.

## Schedule

| Item | Dynamic Camera Calibration | Static Camera Calibration | Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | Blind Spot Radar Calibration | Front Radar Calibration | Multi-System Calibration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calibration price (calibration performed in-house), USD | 249.00 | 349.00 | 449.00 | 329.00 | 429.00 | 895.00 |
| Alignment check fee (alignment check charge on a customer-pay order), USD | 59.95 | 59.95 | 59.95 | 0.00 | 59.95 | 59.95 |
| Alignment correction fee (four-wheel alignment correction charge on a customer-pay order when the check is out of specification), USD | 129.95 | 129.95 | 129.95 | 0.00 | 129.95 | 129.95 |
| Standalone diagnostic fee (diagnostic charge on a customer-requested order when the diagnosis finds no calibration is needed), USD | 79.95 | 79.95 | 79.95 | 79.95 | 79.95 | 79.95 |
| Fleet discount (discount on customer-pay calibration for fleet accounts), percent | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Dealer sublet handling (handling added to the dealer invoice when a sublet is billed to an insurer), percent | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The figures are tier figures: an order is priced at the figures of the tier recorded on it.
2. Blind Spot Radar Calibration carries an alignment check fee and an alignment correction fee of 0.00; it is the only tier at which these two figures are zero.
3. The standalone diagnostic fee, the fleet discount and the dealer sublet handling percentage are the same on every tier: 79.95 USD, 5 percent and 10 percent.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical look-ups)

- Hypothetical order on Front Radar Calibration: calibration price 429.00, alignment check fee 59.95, alignment correction fee 129.95.
- Hypothetical order on Multi-System Calibration: calibration price 895.00; the fleet discount figure is 5 percent and the dealer sublet handling figure is 10 percent, as on every tier.
